## test-CalculateChange.R

| Test | Issue | Reason |
|------|-------|--------|
| `[ CalculateChange ] correctly calculates change from the previous snapshot.` | [#31](https://github.com/Gilead-BioStats/gsm.reporting/issues/31) | Commit-linked. Issue 31 specifically describes calculating delta between current and previous snapshots for Z-score, Metric, Enrollment, Numerator, and Denominator — exactly what the test verifies via `CalculateChange()`. |
| `[ CalculateChange ] correctly calculates change from the previous snapshot.` | [#35](https://github.com/Gilead-BioStats/gsm.reporting/issues/35) | Commit-linked. Issue 35 is specifically about renaming `prevSnapshotDate` to `SnapshotDate_Previous`; the test explicitly checks that `SnapshotDate_Previous` exists in the output columns. |
| `[ CalculateChange ] returns message and dfResults unchanged if dfPrevious not supplied.` | [#31](https://github.com/Gilead-BioStats/gsm.reporting/issues/31) | Commit-linked. Issue 31 is the implementing feature for `CalculateChange()`; the additional comments note "Default to previous snapshot if no date is supplied," which covers the fallback behavior this test validates (message emitted and `dfResults` returned unchanged when no previous data is supplied). |

## test-MakeBounds.R

| Test | Issue | Reason |
|------|-------|--------|
| `MakeBounds has appropriate expected warnings` | [#25](https://github.com/Gilead-BioStats/gsm.reporting/issues/25) | Commit-linked. Issue 25 describes that `MakeBounds` should "alert the user" when there is a mismatch between metric IDs in `results` and `metrics`. The test checks for the exact warning message when metric IDs are absent from `dfMetrics`. |
